nodes.label: Graphify: `uv graphify` generates a static call graph of the codebase. Output is in `graphify-out/` and can be viewed with `index.html` in that folder. The graph includes calls from Android framework entry points (e.g. `Activity.onCreate`) to app code, but does not include external library code (e.g. Compose runtime) or calls between library code.
